label: Retro Post (era flashback)
description: The era flashback: a 2008-web status box (blue-bar social chrome) on an aurora desktop wallpaper, with the film's sentence typing inside it. One deliberate jump to an older internet -- the chrome is the costume, the typing is the performance. Full-bleed beat; the film's one theme-flip chapter card in a paper film. Carries the SAME sentence the film is already writing (use pretyped to continue it, never restart it).

text.label: The full sentence in the status box

pretyped.label: Prefix already standing at frame one (string -- its length is used -- or a count); typing continues from there
